concerns.text: "All experiments must be reproducible via random seed management and artifact versioning (Constitution Principle III)." lacks a concrete verification procedure. Specify how reproducibility will be demonstrated (e.g., a reproducibility checklist, a script that re‑runs the full pipeline and asserts identical outputs within a tolerance).

The definition of a binary “success” outcome (majority vote over three runs) is used for McNemar’s test, while the sensitivity analysis defines success via Levenshtein edit‑distance thresholds. This creates an ambiguous construct for the statistical test and makes the acceptance input for FR-010 unreachable/ill‑defined. Clarify whether the statistical test should operate on the majority‑vote binary label or on the thresholded edit‑distance metric, and ensure the chosen outcome is consistently measurable across all baselines.
